verdict.rationale: Rollbar's marketing says it "points you to the code behind each error," and a community comment mentions "GitHub credentials for source code integration," so some repo connection seems to exist. Item Owner is a manually designated Rollbar user, not repo-derived code owners, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented repo/source-control integration setup, suspect-commit attribution on issues, code-owner mapping from the repo, stack-frame links to the exact line on the default branch, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform connects to my repos so an issue shows suspect commits and code owners, and I can jump from a stack frame to the exact line on my default branch

citations.quote: connects errors, replays, and releases in one place, and points you to the code behind each error.
They wanted an explicit statement that GitHub credentials for source code integration were not compromised.
